class.name: SuperposLockstepClient
class.brief_description: Client half of deterministic input streaming: redundant tick inputs out, relayed command stream in.
class.description: Records exactly one fixed-width input per simulation tick and packs every input the server has not yet reported received, so inputs survive loss on an unreliable [SuperposSession] channel. In the other direction it applies the server's delta-compressed command stream (one input per player slot per tick) strictly in order, letting the client advance the same deterministic world as the server, for example an [EGPBox3DWorld]. Each packed input batch also reports the newest command tick received here in order, which tells the server which ticks it no longer needs to resend. [codeblock] var lockstep := SuperposLockstepClient.new() lockstep.configure(4, 101) # 4-byte inputs, 101 player slots lockstep.load_keyframe(join_table) # or start from tick 1 with an all-zero table # Every simulation tick: lockstep.record_input(tick, my_input) session.enqueue_packet(lockstep.pack_inputs(), INPUT_CHANNEL) # On each received command payload: lockstep.accept_commands(payload) while lockstep.advance_command() != 0: for slot in 101: apply_input(slot, lockstep.get_input(slot)) world.step_tick(world.get_tick() + 1) [/codeblock] Methods must be called on the owning thread.

method.name: acknowledge_inputs
method.description: Discards retained inputs up to and including [param tick], which the server reported received. A tick newer than any recorded input returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA].

method.name: accept_commands
method.description: Buffers a relayed command batch. Ticks already received are ignored. A batch that starts after a gap returns [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]; the client must load a keyframe. Malformed payloads return [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] and change nothing.

method.name: advance_command
method.description: Applies the next buffered command tick to the per-slot input table and returns that tick, or [code]0[/code] when no tick is buffered.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the fixed input width (1-16 bytes), the number of player slots (1-256) shared with the server, and how many received command ticks may wait ahead of the simulation. A batch that would overflow the buffer is rejected whole and resent later. Reconfiguring discards all retained inputs and commands.

method.name: discard_oldest_inputs
method.description: Drops up to [param count] of the oldest unacknowledged inputs and returns how many were dropped. Use it when [method record_input] reports [constant ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY] because the server stopped acknowledging during an outage: the server's playout skips the dropped ticks as lost and resynchronizes when the stream returns.

method.name: get_input
method.description: Returns the input of [param slot] at the most recently applied command tick. A slot that was never set holds zero bytes.

method.name: get_processed_tick
method.description: Returns this client's own input tick that the server consumed at the most recently applied command tick, when the server packs commands with this client as recipient; otherwise [code]0[/code]. Reconcile prediction against it.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns [code]configured[/code], [code]recorded_tick[/code], [code]unacknowledged_inputs[/code], [code]applied_command_tick[/code], [code]newest_command_tick[/code], [code]buffered_commands[/code], [code]processed_tick[/code] and [code]deferred_commands[/code] (batches parked beyond a gap until its repair arrives).

method.name: load_keyframe
method.description: Loads a complete command table produced by [method SuperposLockstepServer.pack_keyframe]. Later command batches continue from its tick. Use this when joining a running simulation together with a world snapshot of the same tick.

method.name: pack_inputs
method.description: Packs the newest unacknowledged inputs that fit in [param max_bytes], up to [param max_ticks], so a saturated uplink never resends an ever-growing backlog; older inputs the server never received are skipped by its playout. Size [param max_ticks] to the redundancy you want (for example half a second of ticks). The default stays inside one unreliable Superpos datagram. Returns an empty array when unconfigured.

method.name: record_input
method.description: Records the input for [param tick]. Ticks must be contiguous and positive and the input must have the configured width. When 128 inputs are unacknowledged the call returns [constant ERR_OUT_OF_MEMORY]; inputs are never dropped silently.
